description: Write the selected files into one zip archive without compression (3D formats are usually compressed already).
inputInstructions:
Writes the selected files, folders or the whole asset into one archive and adds it to the asset as a new file.

Settings (all optional):
  format           zip (default), tar or tar.gz.
  compression      store (default) or deflate; deflate applies to zip only.
  outputFileName   Name of the archive file; the extension for the format is added.
  includePatterns  Glob patterns a file's asset-relative path or name must match to be included.
  excludePatterns  Glob patterns that leave a file out.
  assetVersionId   Archive the file versions recorded in this asset version instead of the current files.

The archive is refused when any selected file is archived, a deleted version, in an archive storage class, or has a blocked file type. Archives of any size are written; outputs over 1 GiB are copied into the asset by the large object copy engine.
